target_customer: Hospitals and clinics in Latin America that lose revenue to patient no shows
problem: Hospitals coordinate appointment confirmations, cancellations and waitlists by phone. Cero automates this over WhatsApp and charges per completed task.
business_model: Usage based, paid per completed task

founders.name: Felipe Rodriguez
previous_startups: Excedent (eligibility and payment API for Chilean health insurers)
founders.background_notes: Former dentist per the YC page; education not listed.

founders.name: Jorge Perez
founders.background_notes: Microsoft Research PhD Fellow and co-creator of Spanish NLP tools including BETO, per the YC page.

founders.name: Mauricio Quezada
education: Universidad de Chile, PhD in computer science
founders.background_notes: Former PhD student of Perez per Diario Financiero.

competitors.name: AgendaPro
competitors.what: Clinic scheduling software with automatic WhatsApp reminders to reduce no shows

technical_complexity.rationale: Spanish language conversational NLP over WhatsApp integrated with hospital scheduling systems, with a team of PhD researchers.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with hospital systems and trust in large hospitals create stickiness; scheduling vendors could add reminders.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; Cero claims 80 percent of high complexity Chilean hospitals use it in some process.

market_need_then: YC page cites a $3.5B Latin American opportunity and 600,000 appointments coordinated monthly in Chile at batch time; patient no shows lengthen waitlists per a co-founder article.

brand_strength.rationale: Short Spanish word for zero (no no shows), but no sources about the brand were found.

outcome_analysis: Cero started bootstrapped and profitable per its YC page, with $97K monthly revenue in August 2021. A June 2026 Diario Financiero profile says it has about 200 clients, 33 staff, around 3 million appointments a month, a doubling last year, and one funding round after YC. That points to steady capital efficient growth, though round details are not public.
notes: The cero.ai site fetch returned only the word CERO, so the site is treated as an uninformative page. Funding after YC: DF says one round with no amount; Standout lists $125K seed and Extruct a Series A; a Corfo subsidy of 2,785 million Chilean pesos is mentioned in one listing. These are unverified, so no round is recorded. Founding year conflicts (2017 YC page, 2020 directory). Competitor page for AgendaPro is undated.
